cues: Look at sulphuric acid and sodium hydroxide.

text: Look at sulphuric acid and sodium hydroxide. One mole of acid needs two moles of base, so the moles do not match. But one mole of sulphuric acid carries two equivalents, and two moles of sodium hydroxide carry two equivalents. The equivalents match exactly.
